# Rules for the one-pass fixtures (rd_onepass_ab): a texture a VU draw samples is
# `date_split` (alpha 0x80 on the left half, 0x40 on the right), so the alpha plan
# (rd_alpha_plan.c) proves a LERP As VU draw's alpha at most 128 (the default rules give an
# alpha-tested draw `alpha_ramp`, alpha 0 to 255, which proves nothing) while its range still
# spans two values (a range of one value 0x80 is the alpha plan's own one-pass rule); the
# default rules otherwise
glyphs     sheet
ramp       r8
date_split date
date_split vu
alpha_ramp ate
bright     additive
gradient   abe
checker    sprite
grey       unused
checker
